uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1164-2173-4740-6123.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-2173-4740-6123.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Necrodominance, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-2173-4740-6123.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

2023-3755-4460-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-728-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

813-1987-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
813-1987-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
813-1987-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-4188-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-6633.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7768.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7692-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7692-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

640-2173-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1824-2530-2906-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2906-7351.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-2906-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1010-4779-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2464-3713-5078-5243.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

261-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3234-3293-4050-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4050-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4050-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

3693-4613-6897.description:
Activate Kraven using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Kraven's deathtouch.
Kraven triggers, causing you to draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat as desired.
3693-4613-6897.notes: You can repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. This loop will work as long as your library isn't empty.

631-2363-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

1183-2034-6872.description:
Activate Pentavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

3532-3581-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-3581-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Kykar and Uthros Research Craft trigger.
Resolve the Uthros Research Craft trigger, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2732-2921-6132.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1558-2361-4840.notablePrerequisites: Sword of Light and Shadow attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1558-2361-4840.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Light and Shadow attached.
Sword of Light and Shadow triggers, causing you to gain three life and return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3263-4385-4659.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2440-3263-4082.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Cats.
2440-3263-4082.description:
Activate Kemba by paying {5}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token.
The Cat enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Kemba trigger, allowing you to attach an Equipment to the Cat token.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2301-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

981-1636-4599.notablePrerequisites: At least four other Zombies on the battlefield.
981-1636-4599.description:
Whenever an opponent casts an instant or Sorcery, sacrifice Cursecatcher to counter that spell unless that opponent pays {1}.
Tap 5 untapped zombies you control to return Cursecatcher to the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

29-645.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
29-645.description:
Declare Alesha as attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B}, returning Master of Cruelties from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Master of Cruelties deals combat damage, causing defending player to change life total to one.
Alesha deals combat damage, killing defending opponent.

864-3890-4050.description:
Sacrifice Eternal Witness to Phyrexian Altar, for {B}.
Cast Unearth, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Unearth from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
